newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat down on commercial selling, harvest.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat down on commercial selling, harvest.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were lower early Wednesday on moderate commercial selling and harvest pressure, traders said.
Near the open, Cargill sold two million bushels July and Term Commodities sold one million July, pit traders said. LIT also sold 500,000 bushels of July.
Advances Wednesday should be limited by reports this week of better-than-expected yields in the hard red winter wheat harvest areas.
Additionally, early harvesting of the soft red winter crop in Arkansas showed good production prospects, agronomists said.
At 1002 CDT, July wheat was down 1-3/4 per bushel at $3.42, and other months were 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 cents down.
